# A Canadian company invoices a US customer, and is later paid
#
# 2,720.00 USD billed and collected into a US dollar account. Every
# transaction that brings the dollars in is stated in US dollars, so none
# carries a Canadian figure and GnuCash's own reconstruction has nothing
# to read. At the year end the company still holds all of them.
# 
# The dollars cost 3,791.14 and are worth 3,771.28, so 19.86 is
# unrealized. Nothing is realized: no dollar has left.
#
# Generated by scripts/generate-multi-currency-examples.sh. Not a
# test fixture — no test draws its figures from here — but the
# statement below is checked against what the tool prints, by
# tests/integration/test_each_worked_example_still_prints_the_statement_it_carries.py.
# Check it yourself:
#
#     gnucash-plaintext import --new /tmp/check.gnucash \
#         examples/multi-currency/a_us_customer_invoiced_and_the_dollars_still_held.txt
#     gnucash-plaintext balance-sheet /tmp/check.gnucash --as-of 2026-12-31
#
# The statement that ledger produces is at the end of this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# What `balance-sheet --as-of 2026-12-31` prints for the book above.
#
# Commented, every line of it. A statement opens with a dated
# directive — `2026-12-31 balance-sheet` — and the import reads a
# line at column 0 as one, so a file carrying both would refuse to
# import and this example would not do the one thing it is for.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# 2026-12-31 balance-sheet
# 	# An account line is that account's own balance — never its children's.
# 	# A section total, and any figure no account holds, is a key.
# 	# share_price: and value: under an account line are what this report
# 	# valued the holding at on this date, not the rate a split happened at.
# 	#
# 	# A gain already taken is stated apart from one the book has yet to
# 	# take, and only the unrealized total reaches total_equity.
# 	# gnucash_balancing_amount is GnuCash's own figure, carried across so
# 	# the two can be read against each other, and added into nothing.
# 	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 	Assets:Bank:USD 2720.00 USD
# 		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 		share_price: "1.3865"
# 		value: "3771.28"
# 	total_assets: 3771.28 CAD
# 	total_liabilities: 0.00 CAD
# 	retained_earnings: 3791.14 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_assets_fx:
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				type: asset
# 				share_price: 1.3865 # current price of commodity in balance sheet currency
# 				cost_bases:
# 					cost_basis:
# 						split_guid: fd536a574b674d7db44343523d77915f
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						cost_basis_balance: 2720.00
# 						cost_share_price: 189557/136000
# 						cost_value: 3791.14 # cost_basis_balance * cost_share_price
# 						value: 3771.28 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 						unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -19.86 # value - cost_value
# 				cost_basis_balance: 2720.00 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_basis_balance
# 				cost_value: 3791.14 # sum of each cost_basis's cost_value
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 3c88e80377d241a88a9040b03c238481
# 						name: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: bb046aab7f1c419e81af87e31a0da3be
# 						name: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						balance: 2720.00
# 				balance_value: 2720.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				value: 3771.28 # cost_basis_balance * share_price
# 				unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -19.86 # value - cost_value
# 		cost_value: 3791.14 # sum of each commodity's cost_value
# 		value: 3771.28 # sum of each commodity's value
# 		unrealized_gains_assets_fx: -19.86 # value - cost_value
# 	unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx: 0.00 CAD
# 	unrealized_gains_fx: -19.86 CAD # unrealized_gains_assets_fx + unrealized_gains_liabilities_fx
# 	realized_gains_fx:
# 		realized_gains_fx: 0.00
# 		splits: # there is no split
# 	realized_gains_other: 0.00 CAD # not yet supported
# 	total_realized_gains: 0.00 CAD # realized_gains_fx + realized_gains_other
# 	unrealized_gains_other: # sum of unrealized_gains_other of all securities and funds
# 		securities: # there is no security or fund
# 		value: 0.00 # sum of each security's value
# 		cost_value: 0.00 # sum of each security's cost_value
# 		unrealized_gains_other: 0.00 # value - cost_value
# 	total_unrealized_gains: -19.86 CAD # unrealized_gains_fx + unrealized_gains_other
# 	gnucash_balancing_amount: # the commodities GnuCash's own figure is summed from
# 		commodities:
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
# 				splits: # there is no split
# 				sum_value: 0.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: fb14ed38ffd2445a82f92a24f86fc104
# 						name: "Assets"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: 952c7e51af344eee8f33bb45f2fb54d9
# 						name: "Assets:Bank"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 				balance_value: 0.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 0.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 0.00 # 0.00 CAD at 1 CAD per CAD
# 			commodity:
# 				commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
# 				splits:
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: d58111d2705345599676b7dadc4efe37
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						value: -2720.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: fd536a574b674d7db44343523d77915f
# 						account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						value: 2720.00
# 					split:
# 						split_guid: 0bc99a385bbd4791a94a1b7698c63c12
# 						account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						value: 2720.00
# 				sum_value: 2720.00 # sum of split's value of all splits
# 				accounts:
# 					account:
# 						guid: 3c88e80377d241a88a9040b03c238481
# 						name: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
# 						balance: 0.00
# 					account:
# 						guid: bb046aab7f1c419e81af87e31a0da3be
# 						name: "Assets:Bank:USD"
# 						balance: 2720.00
# 				balance_value: 2720.00 # sum of account's balance for all accounts
# 				gains_before_conversion: 0.00 # what GnuCash's own figure holds for this commodity
# 				balance_sheet_value: 0.00 # 0.00 USD at 1.3865 CAD per USD
# 		gnucash_balancing_amount: 0.00 # sum of balance_sheet_value of all commodities
# 	total_equity: 3771.28 CAD
# 	total_liabilities_and_equity: 3771.28 CAD
